narrative.overview:
The site is one object: a tear-off calendar hanging from a nail on a break-room wall. A black backer board carries the robot badge and the running tally. A block of white paper leaves hangs under it. Each date is one leaf. The morning plan is printed on the leaf. The evening incident report is a stub below a perforation, typed in red and rubber-stamped once it is filed. Older leaves are torn off and pinned to the wall below.

Everything on screen is one of three surfaces: wall, board or paper. Each has its own inks and they do not mix. The look is flat print. There are no textures, bevels or decorative gradients. The only depth cue is the shadow the calendar casts on the wall.

The joke is the product. The plan is set at headline size and nothing competes with it except the date. This system replaces the earlier dark neon bulletin; none of that look carries over.
keyCharacteristics: Three surfaces: sage wall, black board, white paper.
Three spot inks on paper: black, report red, plan yellow.
The date numeral is the largest element on a dated page.
One line grammar: dotted tears, dashed is not yet, solid is filed.
Two robots on a 9:00 PM shift change. Their art is cropped, never redrawn.
Square corners, flat ink, one shadow.
Motion is paper settling and a stamp landing.

rules.name: The Three Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Every element sits on the wall, the board or the paper, and takes its colours from that surface's tokens. Wall text uses wall inks. Board text uses board inks. Paper uses the three spot inks.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Paper prints in black, Report Red and Plan Yellow and nothing else. Greys on paper are the soft black and the rule colour. Yellow on paper is a fill behind black, never lettering.

rules.name: The Badge Lettering Rule
rules.body: Pink and yellow lettering belongs to the board, where it echoes the badge: pink over yellow. One exception ships: the CLASSIFIED stamp turns Badge Pink on the night wall, because Report Red does not read on Bottle Green.

rules.name: The Night Shift Rule
rules.body: From 9:00 PM local time the root gets `data-shift="night"`. The wall and its inks change to the Bottle Green set, the wall shadow deepens, and the red robot's badge replaces the yellow one on the board. Paper and board tokens do not change. `color-scheme` switches from light to dark. The wall fades over 0.8s.

rules.name: The Biggest Numeral Rule
rules.body: On a dated page the date numeral is the largest element. Nothing on a leaf or a slip is set larger than its date.

rules.name: The Typed Report Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is used for the incident report and its countdown only. Nothing else is typed.

rules.name: The Headline Plan Rule
rules.body: The plan is set at headline size in Libre Franklin 600. It is not a caption under a title.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink is flat. No textures, no bevels, no gradients for decoration. The one CSS gradient in the build draws a solid shape: the torn bites along a slip's top edge.

rules.name: The Line Grammar Rule
rules.body: Dotted is a perforation. Dashed is not printed or not filed yet. Solid is filed. Do not use a dashed or dotted line for anything else.

rules.name: The Two Robots Rule
rules.body: The yellow robot plans in the morning and holds the board by day. The red robot reports in the evening and takes the board at night. Both are binding brand art. The site ships crops of `robot-yellow.jpg` and `robot-red.jpg` (badges and seals). The art is cropped, never redrawn, recoloured or regenerated. Greyscale on a sealed report is the one filter applied.

rules.name: The Paper Moves Rule
rules.body: Only two things animate: the leaf settling and the stamp landing. Slips straighten on hover. Everything else is a 0.2s colour change, plus the 0.8s wall change at the shift. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animations, the slip movement and the wall fade are all removed.

dos: Do place every new element on one of the three surfaces and use that surface's tokens.
Do keep paper to black, Report Red and Plan Yellow. Use Plan Yellow as a fill behind black text.
Do make the date numeral the largest element on any dated page.
Do set the plan at headline size and type the report in Courier Prime in Report Red, Text.
Do use dotted for perforations, dashed for not printed or not filed yet, and solid for filed.
Do use the real robot crops in `src/assets/images/` and keep their provenance files with them.
Do keep corners square on paper, buttons and cells. Only the board's top corners are rounded (5px).
Do keep interactive targets at least 2.75rem tall and keep the 3px focus outline.
Do check new work on both shifts. Anything on the wall must read on Break-Room Sage and on Bottle Green.
donts: Don't add a fourth ink to paper, or a tint of red or yellow.
Don't use pink or yellow lettering off the board.
Don't redraw, recolour, trace or generate the robots, and don't make a stand-in mark.
Don't use textures, bevels, inner shadows or decorative gradients.
Don't add a shadow to anything that is not hanging on or pinned to the wall.
Don't use a dashed or dotted line as decoration.
Don't use Courier Prime for anything but the incident report and its countdown.
Don't animate anything other than paper settling and the stamp landing.
Don't bring back the dark neon terminal look or a feed of post cards.
Don't let the month planner scroll sideways.
